sentences.en: While it may not be the flashiest racer on the market, nor do you get to toy with licenced Ferraris and such, the sensation of speed is definitely here.

sentences.en: The first instinct when looking for a chart might be to look on sites like Amazon.com and just order the flashiest, prettiest design.
